page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Marginal « quotation marks stand in the right margin beside lines 1 to 6. Gathering signature "d 3" at the foot, catchword "mo-" at the lower right. Page number 53 at the top right, running head at the top centre.

main_text.l: scripsit eis, hoc non peti, sed
praestari solere. Et ideo si quis
sis non liceret. Cuius rei testi

page.notes: Marginal « marks (six, right margin, beside lines 1 to 6) transcribed at their line positions. Line 5 "rife," read as "ri se," with the break after "delecta" carrying no printed hyphen; "delectari" is therefore a doubtful reconstruction, not printed. "præstari" (line 3) is read from a ligatured form and may be doubtful. Printed "vim ac momē" has a tilde, transcribed as "momē" with the tilde kept. The printer's "auctorita / tem" break carries no hyphen, so it is written whole.
